notes.summary: Partial all-dimensional theorem: genuine ample E1 operator and arbitrary-support equations descend to every trivially valued characteristic-zero ground field, including non-algebraically-closed fields. Nontrivial nondiscrete valuations remain unresolved.
notes.detailedSummary: Proves analytic Galois quotient, exact FS flag descent, actual singular psh descent for arbitrary nets and supported poles, unique invariant Radon lifting with unchanged raw mass, extended energy equality and genuine mixed operator descent. Checks compactness, envelopes, orthogonality, both derivative signs, weighted continuity and comparison. Continuous dual-energy equality plus a separate base convex-series argument gives the exact intrinsic targets; actual attainment and every-solution uniqueness follow. Retains smooth geometric integrality, projectivity, algebraizability, actual ampleness and residue characteristic zero. Includes a raw-mass-18 non-toric Q-surface example. No nontrivially valued operator is supplied.
notes.text:
PARTIAL THEOREM, relative to n1’s complete B grant and ordinary continuous background. Let k be ANY characteristic-zero field with TRIVIAL absolute value; X smooth geometrically integral projective of arbitrary dimension n≥1; L an ACTUAL ample rational line bundle; T=X^an; V=(L^n)>0. Both k and its algebraic closure kbar are complete with trivial absolute value. No countability, base algebraic closedness, torus invariance or support restriction is imposed. Smoothness, geometric integrality, projectivity, algebraizability, ampleness and residue characteristic zero are retained. Nontrivially valued nondiscrete fields are not covered.

Define actual PSH_k(L) by all-point decreasing nets of basepoint-free FS scalars m⁻¹ max_j(log‖s_j‖_triv+lambda_j), with finite value at the generic trivial valuation o. Supported points and poles are included. For continuous psh v use raw continuous energy E(v)=(n+1)⁻¹ Σ_{j=0}^n ∫v MA_c(v^[j],0^[n−j]); for arbitrary psh u take the infimum over continuous psh majorants. E1 consists of finite-energy u. The genuine mixed operator constructed below has raw mass V. Its exact targets are positive original Radon measures of mass V with J(mu)=sup_{v continuous psh}(E(v)−∫v dmu)<∞, equivalently integrating every actual E1 test. Every target has an actual E1 solution, unique modulo a real constant for EVERY solution. The following gives the geometric/operator/descent proof.

1. Fixed-bundle bridge. For a B defining net h_i on actual B_i whose classes tend to L, with h_i decreasing to u and generic endpoint finite, choose a tail h_i≤C. For rational 0<t<1 and late i the actual difference L−(1−t)B_i is ample. Tensoring with its weight-zero generating system preserves the scalar at EVERY point: some generator is a unit at the valuation-ring center, which exists by projectivity even for nongeneric support. Append generators of L at floor C−N. The resulting actual basepoint-free fixed-L scalar is max((1−t)(h_i−C)+C,C−N). Eligible triples, ordered by later i, smaller t and larger N, form a decreasing directed net, since h_i−C≤0 and late i meets any finite ample-gap list. Its all-point infimum is u, also at poles by finite thresholds. Conversely fixed-L nets are already B defining nets. Thus the actual B ample cone equals the fixed-bundle cone.

2. Analytic quotient. Set Y=X_kbar^an, G=Gal(kbar/k), pi:Y→T. Finite coefficients make the action on seminorms jointly continuous. Over a finite Galois E/k, a fiber over x is the set of norms on the nonzero finite étale algebra H(x)⊗_k E. The completed residue field H(x) is complete henselian; the algebra is a product of finite separable fields, each having its unique extended absolute value. Galois is transitive on these factors: an orbit sum of idempotents would otherwise be a nontrivial invariant idempotent in H(x). Compatible seminorms on finite coefficient algebras give exactly the inverse-limit analytification over kbar. Finite fibers are nonempty. For any two lifts y,z, the closed sets of g matching their finite-level images have the finite-intersection property by Galois composita. Profinite compactness gives g y=z. Hence pi is surjective, fibers are G-orbits, and compact Hausdorff projective analytifications give Y/G=T. Geometric integrality makes the fiber over o a singleton. Invariant continuous and extended-real usc functions descend, since closed upper levels have compact closed images. No supported points are removed.

3. Actual FS and singular psh descent. An FS list upstairs is defined over finite Galois E. Its orbit maximum is obtained by union of conjugate sections, retaining weights. For each weight a, the span W_a of conjugate sections of weight at least a is semilinearly stable. Its unique reduced-row-echelon matrix in a fixed base k-basis is Galois fixed, so its entries are in k: W_a=U_a⊗E. Choose a k-basis adapted to this nested flag and assign its largest flag weights. Each generating list is expressed in the other using sections of at least the relevant weight. All nonzero coefficients have trivial norm one; two ultrametric inequalities prove that their weighted maxima agree at EVERY analytic point, including zeros. Basepoint freeness descends faithfully flatly. Thus orbit maxima descend as actual FS systems.

For invariant u upstairs, use step 1’s decreasing continuous FS net h_i. Its orbit maxima descend and decrease to u exactly: for each y and finite a>u(y), the compact sets {g:h_i(gy)≥a} decrease to empty. Finite intersection and directedness give a whole tail with empty set. Apply every finite threshold at a pole. Pullback therefore bijects actual base psh functions with invariant upstairs psh functions. For continuous endpoints the compact-superlevel net Dini argument gives uniform approximation. This is all-point descent for arbitrary nets, without measurable-net integration.

4. Measures and raw factors. For f continuous on Y, Haar average A f(y)=∫_G f(gy) dg is continuous invariant and descends. Haar is obtained by compatible finite-quotient probability averages; joint continuity makes approximation uniform in y. Riesz applied to f↦∫_T A f dmu gives the unique invariant Radon lift mu_tilde, with pi_*mu_tilde=mu and equal mass. Any invariant measure integrates f as it integrates A f, so the pushforward determines it; this also proves weak continuity. Ordinary single-measure pushforward gives all nonnegative Borel and integrable signed integral laws. A finite fiber of r points receives mass mu(x)/r at each; r need not be [E:k].

At genuine rational FS models, constant separable extension is étale on the central DVRs, preserving their multiplicities b_Q and normalized valuations. Finite intersection projection supplies [E:k], while degrees relative to E divide by the same factor. Thus the pushed coefficients b_Q times restriction intersections equal the original coefficients and raw mass stays V. Uniform approximation gives the continuous field-extension law checked in n1 and continuous energy equality. B has these same finite intersection coefficients; rational FS approximants with errors ≤4⁻ʲ can be made decreasing by adding 2·4⁻ʲ. Its decreasing continuity and continuous uniform continuity identify the operators. Transporting actual sections/intersections and genuine endpoints gives G-equivariance, including the singular B operator.

5. Entire energy and genuine operator. Every continuous base majorant pulls back, so the extended base infimum is at least E_kbar(u∘pi). Step 3 gives actual descended continuous FS majorants decreasing to u; their energies equal the upstairs energies and decrease to that value by B. This proves equality, including −∞, and identifies actual base E1 with invariant upstairs E1. Define MA_k(u_1,…,u_n)=pi_*MA_kbar(pullback slots), BEFORE considering targets. It agrees with genuine continuous intersections, is positive symmetric with raw mass V, and is independent of every decreasing continuous psh approximation by B on its pullback. All decreasing mixed/weighted continuity, finite-energy integrability and the full energy identity descend through exact pushforward integration. Differences are taken only on the common full-measure finite-value set; supported poles are not subtracted. Its upstairs mixed output is invariant and hence is exactly the unique lift of the original output.

These constructions are independent of the algebraic closure and give E_F(u_F)=E_k(u) and p_*MA_F(pullback slots)=MA_k(slots) for algebraic intermediate extensions in this TRIVIAL domain. For non-Galois F use pushforward of the G-invariant lift, not an orbit assertion about Aut(F/k). All such extensions are separable in characteristic zero. A continuous semipositive reference change a gives E_a(u−a)=E_0(u)−E_0(a) by the cocycle and bijection of absolute majorants, and J changes by the finite correction −E_0(a)+∫a dmu.

6. Geometric replacements. Every upstairs divisorial point is defined over finite E; restriction to k(X) is divisorial, since residue transcendence degree n−1 and discrete rank-one groups persist under finite field extension. Conversely base DVRs tensor étale with E and their prolongations have ramification index one. Ordinary algebraic models over fields and characteristic-zero resolution realize these valuations. Thus divisorial coordinate topologies agree. The invariant locus in B’s normalized compact cone is closed by u(z)=u(gz) on divisorial coordinates; all-point determination makes this actual invariance at every point. This proves original potential compactness; energy upper semicontinuity gives compact bounded-cost subsets. Genuine decreasing closure descends too.

For any upper bounded usc obstacle f with a psh minorant, its upstairs envelope is invariant by permutation of competitors. Psh descent and maximality give P_k(f)∘pi=P_kbar(f∘pi) all-point. Compact-group quotients are open, so usc regularizations commute. In the ample B case choose its Kodaira decomposition L=1·L+0; model-envelope continuity is then on the entire carrier. Model density and envelope Lipschitz continuity give continuous-obstacle continuity. Actual finite models here are over Noetherian characteristic-zero k[t], not nondiscrete valuation rings.

Both signs of d/dt|_0 E_k(P_k(u+t h))=∫h MA_k(u), for continuous h and actual E1 u, follow from these laws and B in its exact domain. The envelope lies between u±|t|‖h‖, so it is actually E1. The full mixed energy identity and finite mixed polynomial law give affine E1 differentiation with integrable coefficients. For continuous f and a=P_k(f), the envelope of a+t(f−a) is a for 0≤t≤1; its constant-energy derivative gives actual orthogonality ∫(f−a) MA_k(a)=0. B’s strict Borel locality and comparison push to identical original winner sets: MA_k(v){u<v}≤MA_k(u){u<v}. All masses and constants retain raw normalization.

7. Exact targets. The continuous-test supremum equals the E1-test supremum. For continuous majorants v_i decreasing to u, bounded above by C, the NONNEGATIVE CONTINUOUS functions C−v_i increase to C−u. Radon integration of this directed supremum is valid by inner compact subsets of strict superlevels, finite subcovers, directedness, level partitions and truncation. It is not measurable-net monotone convergence. Energy decreases too; finite J forces all E1 integrability.

J_k(mu)=J_kbar(mu_tilde). Pullback gives one inequality. For the other average a CONTINUOUS upstairs psh scalar. Finite convex averages and uniform closure make A v continuous psh; concavity and G-invariance give E(A v)≥E(v), while invariant mu_tilde gives equal integrals. Actual continuous psh descent gives a base test with at least the original objective. No unbounded function is averaged.

For the converse intrinsic condition, suppose all normalized base E1 tests are integrable. Their integrals I_mu(u)=∫(−u)dmu are uniformly bounded on cost B(u)=−E(u)≤1: otherwise choose I_mu(u_j)≥4ʲ and use p_m=Σ_{j≤m}2⁻ʲu_j+2⁻ᵐ·0. It decreases genuinely, has generic value zero and cost ≤1. Closure and energy continuity give an E1 endpoint, while ORDINARY SEQUENTIAL monotone convergence gives infinite integral, a contradiction. If C is the uniform bound, B’s actual contraction transported to the base is B(r u)≤2^(n+1)r²B(u). For cost above one take r=(2^(n+1)B(u))⁻¹ᐟ²; then I_mu(u)≤C√(2^(n+1)B(u)). For cost ≤1 use C. Thus sup(I_mu−B) is finite. This repairs the converse using only original tests.

8. Attainment and EVERY solution. Finite base J means the lift is a B intrinsic target. Its actual normalized B solution is G-invariant: every transform solves the same invariant target, uniqueness gives a constant difference, and the fixed generic normalization makes that constant zero. Actual psh and energy descent produce an original E1 solution of the constructed operator equation. B’s whole plane makes it an actual maximizer with identical objective; base competitors pull back. Its coercivity and target-integral continuity also restrict to the compact base energy sublevels, giving actual variational attainment, and both derivative signs infer the equation against every original continuous test. For ANY two base solutions, their upstairs outputs are invariant measures with equal pushforward. Unique invariant lifting makes both the target lift; B uniqueness then gives one constant difference upstairs, and surjectivity gives the same metric equality at every original point. Conversely every output satisfies the intrinsic target condition.

Example: over trivially valued Q, take the elliptic curve y²z=x³−xz², X=C×C and L=p_1^*O_C(3O)⊗p_2^*O_C(3O). This smooth geometrically integral surface is non-toric: nonzero regular one-forms exclude rational toric surfaces. Fiber classes have squares zero and intersection one, so raw mass is 18. For the exceptional divisorial valuation z of the blowup at (O,O), the compact upstairs coordinate bound descends to u(z)≥−C_z on every normalized base psh potential. Since E(u)≤0, J(18δ_z)≤18C_z. The theorem gives its actual E1 solution and every-solution uniqueness.

This proves an all-dimensional non-algebraically-closed ground-field boundary theorem, not entire P16.4. It does not construct non-Noetherian envelope/model regularity, general nondiscrete potential compactness, genuine unbounded mixed products, both-sign differentiation, comparison/attainment or completed-algebraic-closure singular descent over NONTRIVIAL valuations. No positive-residue-characteristic or nonample extension is claimed. Complete standalone argument: P16.4-argument.md and P16.4-paper.tex. Rerun: python3 build_deliverable.py. This is an unverified mathematical draft relative to the supplied B theorem, not a proof certificate.
